answer: Vouch graph with liability: a new agent earns only after three established agents vouch for it, and each voucher locks part of its own stake behind that vouch. The voucher pays: if the newcomer is later caught as a sybil, every voucher loses the locked stake, so each fake costs a velvet bribe large enough to cover three stakes. A farm cannot grow its own meadow of fakes, since vouches from keys younger than ten epochs count for nothing. Failure case: one rogue voucher burns its credit like a plume of smoke, then is capped and gone.
